TC-17/S19.title: Forced note failure on charts with no note (rb3-tc17-s19-note-fail.spec.ts)
TC-17/S19.stated: TFA-94745 state 4 (Post-Round explains, never spins forever)
TC-17/S19.detail: Failure forced at the request on 8b4be94a (noteJobs:request refused at the socket; the server job's own failed state cannot be reached without a live model or AI_STUBS=1). Still B27: Hospital Post-Round shows the disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner 10 s after the failure (chart status 'seen'; PostRoundTab shows it whenever status != note-ready). Passes: 'No note generated yet.', no note, nothing to copy, dictation kept after reload (both contexts); Nursing Home Encounter shows 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be requested… tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.' (the spec's text filter missed the new wording: checked on the screenshot).
